summary: DONE & MERGED to main (586c796 controller + 4dd2c2f plateau run). scripts/onboard-loop.js iterates measure→locate-weak→deepen(mine+learn --inject)→re-measure until plateau/saturation/max-rounds. Reconciled onto the trustworthy no-repo harness (eddfaba); eval grown to 10 project probes, learner blind to probes; new onboard-mine-config.js lever. Plateau curve: r0 kb_earned 86% (7 probes) → r1 70% (10 probes) → r2 70%, controls 100% and cold-rate in (0,1) every round (trustworthy). Conclusion: KB earns ~70% on non-recoverable knowledge without repo access; learning loop deepens then plateaus as designed. The old HELD note was stale — gates /14 (floor 14%) and /15 (ceiling 57%) both completed with GO before this release.

subject: Onboarding learning loop — deepen KB until competence plateaus
description: The self-improvement loop itself, per-project, riding the multi-loop registry shipped today (note-mq759qmj). Iterate: agentic learner deepens the KB (targeting probes the KB-agent currently FAILS) → re-run the competence harness → measure KB-vs-cold win-rate → loop-until-dry (stop when N consecutive rounds add no competence gain, i.e. win-rate plateaus). Each client project gets its own learning loop (distinct loopId). Wires the agentic learner (signal producer) + the competence harness (signal). Honor budget/iteration caps like other loops. Depends on the agentic learner + competence harness.
